title: GTA 6 Island Poacher FF-50 Location and Guide
description: Discover the secret SAW island in GTA 6 where you become the hunted. Learn where to find the legendary Sniper Rifle FF-50 by defeating the hunter.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the Secret SAW Island and Legendary Sniper Rifle in GTA 6

As anticipation continues to build for the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, gaming media outlets like GameRant have begun highlighting intriguing secrets hidden within the game's vast open world. Among the most discussed recent discoveries is a secret SAW island that offers a uniquely perilous experience for intrepid players.

### Into the Danger Zone: The Hunted Experience

According to reports, stepping foot onto this secret SAW island fundamentally changes the gameplay dynamic, instantly casting your character as the hunted. This tense survival scenario forces players to rely entirely on their combat instincts and situational awareness to navigate hostile territory where danger lurks around every corner.

### Claiming the Legendary Sniper Rifle

Survival on the island is no easy feat, but the reward justifies the immense risk. Players who manage to outmaneuver and defeat the hunter will be handsomely rewarded with a legendary Sniper Rifle. For players who prefer long-range dominance and high-damage tactical options, securing this weapon will be a top priority during their open-world adventures.

### Editor's Take

**Editor's Take:** Rockstar Games has always excelled at embedding rewarding secrets and intense encounters into their open-world environments. Turning the tables on the player by making them the prey adds a thrilling layer of challenge to GTA 6, making the reward of a legendary sniper rifle all the more satisfying to earn.
